mainEntity.name: What is typically included in a primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary suite addition typically includes a large bedroom, a dedicated private bathroom, and one or more walk-in closets. Many homeowners also choose to incorporate sitting areas, dressing spaces, or direct outdoor patio access. Because the addition includes a full bathroom with features like double vanities or walk-in showers, the project requires rough-in plumbing, dedicated electrical circuits, and proper ventilation alongside structural framing and drywall installation. Planning these elements early helps ensure the layout supports your daily routine without crowding essential storage.
acceptedAnswer.description: A primary suite addition typically includes a spacious bedroom, a private en-suite bathroom, and walk-in closets, along with integrated plumbing and dedicated electrical systems.
